lines.text: Martin, it's me. I talked to your old boss today. He says you haven't been right since the funeral. Are you still seeing Doctor Hale?
No. I stopped going. What would I even tell her?
That I see things, Jack. Someone at the end of the hall. And when I look again, he's gone.
And I hear worse. Laughing. Footsteps. Someone knocking, and nobody there.
I don't know. I think so. They don't help.
Call Doctor Hale tomorrow. Please. I love you, man.
